correctness.rationale: HEADLINE (named G9): verified independently. G9 facets [014,018,025,027,034,035,078,123,126,134,168,235,267,678] form a triangulated 2-sphere: V-E+F=9-21+14=2, every edge in exactly 2 facets, every vertex link a cycle, simplicial H=(1,0,1) (replayed verify.py -> VERIFY_OK). DGA model R(K)=Lambda[u]x k[K] checked: d^2=0 on all 512 multidegrees, Leibniz on all 6799 small disjoint pairs. Missing edges include {06},{17}; K_{0167} is hollow 4-cycle 0-1-6-7-0 (edges 01,07,16,67 present; diagonals 06,17 missing; no triangle inside, no S-facet inside). Classes a=[e_0] in C({06}), b=[e_1] in C({17}) are closed and non-exact (domain C0=0). Product e_0*e_1=e_{01} (shuffle +1) is closed since 016,017 not faces. Non-exactness is hand-checkable: d(e0)=e01+e07, d(e1)=e01-e16, d(e6)=-e16+e67, d(e7)=e07+e67, so e01=d(sum c_v e_v) needs c0+c1=1,c0+c7=0,c1+c6=0,c6+c7=0 whose alternating sum gives 0=1; exact rational rank test confirms e01 not in col(d1). Hence [{06}] cup [{17}]=[{0167}]!=0 in H^6(Z_G9), so Q[G9] not Golod and target universal-vanishing false. Field transfer sound: obstruction is integral 0=1 system unsolvable over any field (independently brute-forced no solution over GF(p) for p=2,3,5,7,101); full-subcomplex homology of S^2 triangulation torsion-free. Wider scans (24 nonzero missing-edge products, Tor+ dim 227, Poincare pairings into (9,3) top class) corroborate. UNIVERSAL EXTENSION (every gluing facet choice non-Golod): mathematically TRUE — independent re-run of all 3 stacked-facet orbits x all 6 octahedron bijections (18 complexes) finds verified C4 witness in every case with sphere check. RESIDUAL EVIDENCE DEFECT: archived enumerate_check.py has indentation bug (lines 164-172: inner `for q` loop body only builds G; dedented block after loop processes only last q, so script as archived tests 1 gluing per Sf orbit, 3 total, printing `distinct glued facet sets: 1`), overstating `every gluing choice' coverage. Truth unaffected (independently cured), core named-G9 proof unaffected (verify.py clean). S-uniqueness/stack presentation claim not needed for headline.

material_sources.title: [PDF] TWO-DIMENSIONAL GOLOD COMPLEXES 1. Introduction
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Broader 2-dimensional Golod classification (Iriye-Kishimoto follow-up to 1506.08970): Theorem 1.7 states a 2-dimensional complex is Golod iff its 1-skeleton is chordal and every full subcomplex with vertex-breakable H2 is 1-neighborly; Theorem 1.3 recalls surface-triangulation Golod iff 1-neighborly. Hypotheses are generic over all 2-complexes/surface triangulations; conclusion is an abstract Golod/non-Golod criterion. Applied to G9 it implies abstract non-Golodness (G9 has missing edges {06},{17} and induced C4 K_0167, hence non-chordal/non-neighborly), but it does not name the 9-vertex facet list 014...678, the pair [{06}]x[{17}], the cycle K_0167, the 0=1 non-exactness system, the 24-product table, Tor+ dim 227/205, or the 18-gluing enumeration.

material_sources.title: Tight Complexes Are Golod
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Tight-complexes-are-Golod theorem: a triangulation of a closed connected orientable manifold is Golod iff it is tight. Hypothesis is tightness of a manifold triangulation; conclusion is Golodness. G9 is a 2-sphere triangulation whose tightness is not established in the source and whose exact Tor witness (named facets, C4, 0=1 obstruction) is never mentioned. At most implies abstract non-Golodness conditional on a further tightness check, not the submitted exact Q-certificate.

material_sources.title: [PDF] the homotopy types of moment-angle complexes for flag complexes
material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Grbic-Panov-Theriault-Wu flag-complex theory: for flag K, Golodness is the criterion for Z_K a wedge of spheres (via Berglund-Jollenbeck cup-product reformulation), and minimally-non-Golod flag rings correspond to connected sums of two-sphere products. Hypothesis explicitly requires flag; G9 is non-flag (missing edges {06},{17} plus 14 facets including cross-block triangles), so the theorem does not apply to G9. Provides only contrast/background, no G9 facet, product, or enumeration coverage.

material_sources.relationship_to_claim: Kovyrshina-Panov 2408.04843: for 3-dimensional simplicial spheres, H*(Z_K) is a connected-sum-of-sphere-products ring iff (a) boundary of 4-cross-polytope, (b) 1-skeleton chordal, or (c) exactly two missing edges forming a chordless 4-cycle. Hypothesis dimension is 3-spheres, so it does not literally cover the 2-sphere G9 (9 vertices, 14 facets, many more than two missing edges). Shares chordal/C4 vocabulary but states no G9-specific facet, witness pair, or Tor ledger.
